description: Hot water heater ruptured from a freeze/burst cycle over winter, recurring across both missions. Crew 16 diagnosed the root cause: a valve left closed at the end of Crew 15's mission trapped water, which froze and burst the tank.
response: Crew 15 had worked around an earlier rupture; Crew 16 removed the unit entirely. No hot water was available for either mission.
lesson: Winter closure checklist must include both draining the water heater AND leaving the valve open — both steps are required. Source a replacement heater as a pre-mission supply.
pattern_tag: winter closure checklist gap (valve left closed)
source_citation: SRC-hypatia-iii-brief, Part IV – Incident and emergency register, §4.1 Technical failures, lines 512-517. Register Crew tag: 'C15/C16'. Sol: not stated; placed early in C16's arrival-diagnostics window since Crew 16 diagnosed and removed the unit during hab rehabilitation. Confidence (A) rationale: specific causal chain (valve state at prior mission's closure -> freeze -> rupture) matches the brief's own cross-cutting note (line 832) attributing this to a documented closure-procedure error; reads as formal engineering diagnosis.
